tools.name: find_acts
tools.description: Start discovery of official Italian acts from the user's citation, common name or topic. Preserve dates, constraints and article references in request. For a next-page request without a returned cursor, make no tool call: ask for that cursor instead of searching again. Returns act locators and candidates, without article text. Empty discovery does not prove legal absence.

tools.name: continue_acts
tools.description: Continue discovery only with an actual returned d1_ cursor from find_acts or continue_acts, copied literally. If none is available, make no tool call: ask for the cursor in one short sentence. Never invent a cursor or use article/index/whole-act cursors. Search uses a live corpus; completion describes this traversal, not exhaustive legal relevance.

cursor.description: Copy an actual d1_ cursor returned by discovery, without changes. No placeholders or guesses. If none was returned, ask before calling this tool.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List verified article occurrences and attachment references using an act_locator from find_acts. Initial snapshot_date defaults to today and freezes. Continuation: call list_articles with only the literal cursor and optional page_size; omit act_locator and snapshot_date. Never send this cursor to continue_acts. Entries are this page; inspect coverage and progress for completeness.

act_locator.description: Initial call only; omit when cursor is present.

snapshot_date.description: Initial call only; omit on continuation. The cursor retains the frozen date.

cursor.description: Copy the returned cursor literally. For continuation, supply only cursor and an optional page_size or max_chars; omit every original target and date.

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: Read an article_locator from list_articles, or an act_locator plus article_reference (e.g. '13'), without listing first. snapshot_date defaults to today for the act path; exact locators freeze the date. Continuation: call read_article with only the literal cursor and optional max_chars; omit all locators, article_reference and snapshot_date. Unresolved does not prove absence.

act_locator.description: Initial call only; omit when cursor is present.

article_locator.description: Initial call only; omit when cursor is present.

article_reference.description: Initial act-locator call only; omit when cursor is present.

snapshot_date.description: Initial call only; omit on continuation. The cursor retains the frozen date.

cursor.description: Copy the returned cursor literally. For continuation, supply only cursor and an optional page_size or max_chars; omit every original target and date.

tools.name: read_act
tools.description: Read bounded text and table cells using an act_locator; optionally select a listed attachment_ref. snapshot_date defaults to today and freezes. Continuation: call read_act with only the literal cursor and optional max_chars; omit act_locator, attachment_ref and snapshot_date. If the whole act was requested, follow returned cursors without asking again. Entries are this page; traversal completion is distinct from legal-content coverage.

act_locator.description: Initial call only; omit when cursor is present.

attachment_ref.description: Initial call only; omit when cursor is present.

snapshot_date.description: Initial call only; omit on continuation. The cursor retains the frozen date.

cursor.description: Copy the returned cursor literally. For continuation, supply only cursor and an optional page_size or max_chars; omit every original target and date.

tools.name: recent_updates
tools.title: Acts whose consolidated text was amended
tools.description: List acts whose consolidated text was amended in an inclusive date window of at most twelve months. For new Gazette publications use find_acts with an explicit publication window. These metadata do not establish what changed; read content before describing amendments.
